items.source: use of PathMatcher is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 在 Web 模块中，运行时使用PathMatcher已被弃用，应改用PathPatternParser解析的模式。

items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 PathMatcher 和 UrlPathHelper 已弃用，在 Web 模块中运行时建议使用通过 PathPatternParser 解析的模式。

items.source: Note: This property is mutually exclusive with setPatternParser(PathPatternParser). If set, it enables use of String path matching, unless a PathPatternParser is also explicitly set in which case this property is ignored.
items.translation: 注意： 此属性与setPatternParser(PathPatternParser)互斥。如果设置，它将启用字符串路径匹配，除非也显式设置了PathPatternParser，在这种情况下将忽略此属性。

items.source: Return the PathPatternParser to use, if configured.
items.translation: 返回已配置的PathPatternParser以供使用。

items.source: By default, as of 6.0, a PathPatternParser with default settings is used, which enables parsed patterns. Set this property to null to fall back on String path matching via AntPathMatcher instead, or alternatively, setting one of the above listed AntPathMatcher related properties has the same effect.
items.translation: 默认情况下，从 6.0 版本开始，会使用具有默认设置的PathPatternParser，该设置会启用解析后的patterns。将此属性设置为null可回退到通过AntPathMatcher进行字符串路径匹配，或者，设置上述列出的任一AntPathMatcher相关属性也具有相同的效果。

items.source: Consider using HandlerTypePredicate to group controllers.
items.translation: 考虑使用HandlerTypePredicate来分组控制器。

items.source: By default, this is an instance of UrlPathHelper with default settings.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是一个具有默认设置的UrlPathHelper实例。

items.source: By default, this is an instance of AntPathMatcher with default settings.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是一个具有默认设置的AntPathMatcher实例。

items.source:
Configure path matching options. The options are applied to the following:
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.requestMappingHandlerMapping(ContentNegotiationManager, ApiVersionStrategy, FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.viewControllerHandlerMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.beanNameHandlerMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.routerFunctionMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider, ApiVersionStrategy)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.resourceHandlerMapping(ContentNegotiationManager, FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
items.translation:
配置路径匹配选项。这些选项应用于以下内容：
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.requestMappingHandlerMapping(ContentNegotiationManager, ApiVersionStrategy, FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.viewControllerHandlerMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.beanNameHandlerMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.routerFunctionMapping(FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider, ApiVersionStrategy)
  • WebMvcConfigurationSupport.resourceHandlerMapping(ContentNegotiationManager, FormattingConversionService, ResourceUrlProvider)

items.source:
Whether to prefer PathMatcher. This is the case when either is true:
  • PathPatternParser is explicitly set to null.
  • PathPatternParser is not explicitly set, and a PathMatcher related option is explicitly set.
items.translation:
是否优先使用 PathMatcher。在以下任一情况发生时，会如此：
  • PathPatternParser 被显式设置为 null。
  • PathPatternParser 未被显式设置，且某个与 PathMatcher 相关的选项被显式设置。

items.source: Set the PathPatternParser to parse patterns with for URL path matching.
items.translation: 将 `PathPatternParser` 设置为解析用于 URL 路径匹配的 patterns。

items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: Return the configured PathPatternParser or a default, shared instance otherwise.
items.translation: 返回配置的 PathPatternParser 实例，否则返回默认的共享实例。

items.source: Return the configured UrlPathHelper or a default, shared instance otherwise.
items.translation: 返回配置的 UrlPathHelper 实例，否则返回默认的共享实例。

items.source: Return the configured PathMatcher or a default, shared instance otherwise.
items.translation: 返回配置的 PathMatcher，否则返回默认的共享实例。

items.source: patternParser - the parser to pre-parse patterns with
items.translation: patternParser - 用于预解析模式的解析器

items.source: prefix - the prefix to apply
items.translation: prefix - 要应用的名称前缀

items.source: Prefixes are used to enrich the mappings of every @RequestMapping method whose controller type is matched by the corresponding Predicate. The prefix for the first matching predicate is used.
items.translation: 前缀用于丰富每个由相应`Predicate`匹配的控制器类型的`@RequestMapping`方法的映射。使用第一个匹配的前缀。

items.source: Configure a path prefix to apply to matching controller methods.
items.translation: 配置一个路径前缀，将其应用于匹配的控制器方法。

items.source: predicate - a predicate for matching controller types
items.translation: predicate - 用于匹配控制器类型的谓词

items.source: Brian Clozel, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: 布莱恩·克洛泽，罗森·斯托扬切夫
